dc:title: Electronic line calling in professional tennis, by tournament and season (2017 to 2026)
dc:description: How lines were called at the Grand Slams, ATP Masters 1000, WTA 1000, the season finals and the main team events from 2017 to 2026: line judges, a player challenge system, or live electronic line calling. One row per event, season and tour, each with a source link and a confidence level.

columns.name: tour
columns.dc:description: ATP, WTA, combined (Grand Slams, one row for both tours) or team (team events).

columns.name: line_calling
columns.dc:description: How lines were called. See the README for each value.

columns.name: elc_system
columns.dc:description: The electronic system the source names. Blank when the source names none.

columns.name: challenge_review
columns.dc:description: Whether players could challenge or ask for a review of calls.

columns.name: notes
columns.dc:description: A short plain note on the row.

columns.name: source_url
columns.dc:description: The page that supports the row.

columns.name: source_title
columns.dc:description: The title of that page. A wire service credit may follow in brackets.

columns.name: source_date
columns.dc:description: The publication date shown on the source page. Blank when the page shows none we trust.

columns.name: confidence
columns.dc:description: confirmed, inferred or unknown. See the README.
